channel.title: Wire — Go
channel.description: Go from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: The API design notes
item.description: Proposed Go SIMD API as of 2026-11-16. GitHub Gist: instantly share code, notes, and snippets. (1 source: golangweekly)

item.title: go/analysis moving into the standard library
item.description: Background: Today, the cmd module (in GOROOT/src/cmd) contains a vendored copy of the golang.org/x/tools/go/analysis package, which defines the interface between analyzers (also known as linters) and driver tools such as cmd/vet. To impl... (1 source: golangweekly)

item.title: Go 1.28 Will Let You Write return {}, err
item.description: Go 1.28 is set to let you drop the type from a composite literal when the compiler can infer it from the place where the value goes. (1 source: golangweekly)

item.title: Making Games with the Entity Component System Pattern
item.description: Entity Component System (ECS) is how I structure my hobby games in Go. I show it on two small games built with Donburi and Ebitengine and explain where ECS gets in the way. (1 source: golangweekly)

item.title: Build, Review, and Profile Go Code with Agents in GoLand
item.description: Today, we're building a Go webhook receiver with Air in GoLand: running tasks in parallel, checking with IDE tools, and profiling with a new skill. (1 source: golangweekly)

item.title: Compile-Checked Go Queries via Generic Methods
item.description: How ant uses pointers to struct fields as column references, why the chain needed Go 1.27's generic methods, what it costs, and where it still fails. (1 source: golangweekly)
